findings.summary: Pinned record backends share typed shapes, absence and truthiness rules; borrowed optional values retain borrowing.
Feature-independent runtime layouts share the core PCH; browser file storage allocates on use and platform callbacks retain one wrapper.
Both unit packers share template dependency reach; lowered declaration analysis reuses tokens and checks eligibility before weighting.
Structured regions retain capture metadata in the shared outliner.
Packed namespace arrays use shared storage and preserve declaration attributes.
Closure capture analysis uses the shared identifier reader.
Pinned declaration discovery uses the shared bounded AST walk.
Pinned closure name scopes have one owner.
String truth tests and logical selection borrow their operands.
Reached-loop expansion maps allocate only for nodes with expansion edges.
Transactional map writes share presence and previous-value lookups.
Document dependency resolution skips bound and unrelated identifiers.
Recursive bodies share the group-member list while owning distinct self bindings.
Particle continuation snapshots use shared numeric array emission and typed-array store conversions.
Native particle continuations omit duplicate frozen tables and repeated blob texture extraction.
Particle bridge synchronization reads one typed row instead of dispatching column-name strings per field.
Runtime particle origins enter through registration and are owned by the created mappings.
